title: Inheritance and Alibi Anew
author: Vesper Iversen
blurb: Mara Vasquez, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
